verdict.rationale: SumUp documents agent access to its APIs through a managed MCP server and an Agent Toolkit, plus API keys and a JS SDK. However, the stated MCP scope covers account management, checkouts and payments, not reading transaction history or payouts. Webhooks only report checkout status changes, so there is no evidence of push-based settlement or payout data for reconciliation. Missing for 10: documented transaction-listing and payout/settlement endpoints, agent or MCP tools for retrieving that data, any reconciliation or ledger-export guidance, and hands-on corroboration.
